answers.1_v4_contradictions: 14 contradictions found (7 P0-CRITICAL). All resolved in v5: anti-correlation r range corrected, segmenter/matcher counts corrected, CFR reduction range corrected to 37.5-84.4%, training-free/calibration-free fixed, algorithm corrected to post-hoc, component ablation data noted as unreliable, equivalence claim corrected.
answers.2_code_vs_writing: Code issues: component ablation data unreliable (all variants identical), RRN single small split (12 test queries). Writing issues: all P0 problems are writing overclaims now fixed in v5.
answers.3_lemmas_theorem_retained: NO. Three Lemmas and Theorem replaced with Geometric Hypotheses (H1-H3) + Empirical Mechanism Analysis + Testable Predictions. No formal theorem language in v5.
answers.4_anticorrelation_passes_independent_con: PARTIALLY. Split-reference correlation significant (r=-0.51), GT-free instability significant (r=-0.59), partial correlation significant (r=-0.25). But Null 1 (random beta) reproduces 94% of correlation. Query-level reanalysis further qualifies: only SAM-B pipelines significant after Holm correction.
answers.5_null_correlation: Null 1 (random beta): r=-0.583; Null 2 (shuffled): r=+0.643; Null 3 (uniform): r=+0.381. Observed: r=-0.619. Effect size vs Null 1: Δr=-0.036.
answers.6_after_controlling_mean_dice: YES at query level for SAM-B pipelines. L+SAM-B: r_partial=-0.381 (p=0.0005). B+SAM-B: r_partial=-0.500 (p<0.001). But L+SAM-L: r_partial=-0.064 (p=0.575), L+SAM2-T: r_partial=+0.129 (p=0.255). Association is pipeline-specific.
answers.7_ramp_actual_inference: Post-hoc Selective Prediction (Option A). Stage 1: matcher→f1-f3 for all refs. Stage 2: SAM→mask for all refs. Stage 3: compute f4 from masks. Stage 4: risk predictor→scores. Stage 5: accept/abstain via coverage ranking.
answers.8_matcher_segmenter_passes_per_query: K+1 matcher calls (query + K references), K SAM calls. With K=6: 7 matcher + 6 SAM = 13 model passes per query. Risk predictor adds negligible cost (<1ms).
answers.9_ramp_training_free: NO. RAMP uses gradient-boosted tree risk predictor trained on labeled multi-reference data. v5 correctly describes it as 'supervised risk estimator with frozen matcher and segmenter'.
answers.10_calibration_free: NO. IDRID ECE=0.477. v5 correctly describes it as 'coverage-based ranking without fixed probability threshold'.
answers.11_query_level_statistics_significant: YES for SAM-B pipelines. Anti-correlation: L+SAM-B r=-0.512 (Holm p<0.001), B+SAM-B r=-0.549 (Holm p<0.001). SAM-L (r=-0.221, p=0.049) fails Holm. SAM2-T (r=-0.111, p=0.325) and SAM2-S (r=-0.179, p=0.113) not significant. RAMP CFR reduction: 37.5-84.4% at 80% coverage.
answers.12_matcher_equivalent: NO. p>0.05 does not equal equivalence. v5 correctly states 'no statistically significant difference detected'.
answers.13_rrn_retained: APPENDIX ONLY. AUROC=0.612 < 0.65 threshold. Dice@Top-3 advantage +0.009 < +0.010. Only 12 test queries, 0 catastrophic cases. Evaluated in Appendix A of v5.
answers.14_fair_external_baselines: GF-SAM and MAUP use SAM-H (not SAM-B). CycleSAM uses SAM-B (fair). H-SAM not reference-guided. SAM-Med2D checkpoint blocked. v5 clearly marks backbone differences in Table 4.
answers.15_strongest_credible_claim: Reference reliability estimation is a missing component in visual prompting. RAMP with supervised risk estimator achieves 37.5-84.4% CFR reduction at 80% coverage. The instability-CFR association is a reproducible empirical pattern in SAM-B pipelines (r=-0.51, partial r=-0.38 after controlling mean Dice), but does not generalize to SAM2 pipelines.
answers.16_withdrawn_claims: training-free, calibration-free, formal theorem proves anti-correlation, six segmenters and four matchers, 56-84% CFR reduction (now 37.5-84.4%), identical conditions (now shared protocol, backbone differences noted), equivalence (now no significant difference), reference reliability dominates prompt sophistication (now orthogonal dimension), anti-correlation is universal (now pipeline-specific), component ablation values (data unreliable)
